# tests/fixtures

Generated by `sb_fixture_builder` (run from the `src/cpp` directory):

- `minimal.sbm1` — SBM1 module with one known import (`sb.memory.v1`), tiny payload.
- `unresolved.sbm1` — module with an unknown import (`sb.unknown.v9`); the
  loader must report it and fail the load, never fake success.
- `constant.sbvs` — constant-color SBVS shader matching the D3D12 smoke color.
- `alu.sbvs` — exercises ADD/MUL/MAD plus verifier def-before-use rules.

All fixtures are project-owned synthetic data. No commercial content.
